Discoverer: Ceri Coburn from Pen Test Partners
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems with EAP installed
VMware vSphere via the vSphere Client
Attack Vector: Tricking a target domain user into requesting and relaying service tickets for arbitrary Active Directory Service Principal Names (SPNs)
Seizing a privileged EAP session with unprivileged local access

Method of Attack: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities due to inadequate content filtering
Attack Vector: Tricking an administrator into clicking on a malicious link

Method of Attack: Running Apex code in 'without sharing' mode to ignore user permissions
Providing specially crafted input to alter execution flow
Attack Vector: Exploiting misconfigurations in the Apex programming language
